title: Dan Abramov: Beyond React 16 | JSConf Iceland
summary: Dan Abramov's JSConf Iceland talk on what came after React 16, with live-coded prototypes of async rendering and time slicing. It previews the ideas that became concurrent mode and suspense.
why: Recommended as the clearest demo of what concurrent rendering solves, including the memorable clock animation.

quote.text: That clock animation is pure genius
